scope: Copied from upstream with the local changes below. Licence text: LICENSE
copied_from: thermos/LICENSE -> LICENSE; thermos/skills/thermos/SKILL.md -> SKILL.md; thermos/skills/thermo-nuclear-review/SKILL.md -> references/review-rubric.md; thermos/skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review/SKILL.md -> references/code-quality-rubric.md
local_changes: SKILL.md: rewritten. It takes a range argument (A..B, or a base) instead of assuming main, and stops to ask for a base when origin/HEAD is not set.
SKILL.md: starts general-purpose subagents and points each at its rubric file, in place of Cursor's named Task subagents.
SKILL.md: the parent gathers only the diff stat and file list; reviewers fetch the diff file by file.
SKILL.md: adds a fixed finding format and an 'Incomplete:' first line when a reviewer fails, so a scheduled caller can tell a partial review apart.
references/review-rubric.md, references/code-quality-rubric.md: the two rubric skills are now reference files without frontmatter, so they can no longer be invoked on their own.
references/review-rubric.md: the PR discussion step uses gh only (not glab), names BugBot only as an example, and is skipped when gh is missing or no PR covers the range.
left_out: thermos/README.md, thermos/CHANGELOG.md: describe the Cursor plugin
thermos/agents/*.md: wrappers for Cursor's Task subagents, replaced by step 3 of SKILL.md
